steps.js: return [...document.querySelectorAll("body *")].filter(e=>/sticky|fixed/.test(getComputedStyle(e).position) && e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0).map(e=>{const s=getComputedStyle(e), r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); return e.tagName+"."+String(e.className).slice(0,30)+" pos="+s.position+" top="+s.top+" rtop="+Math.round(r.top)+" h="+Math.round(r.height)+" w="+Math.round(r.width)}).slice(0,10)
